invariant_argument: Carrier: ModularData fields are private and have no public mutator or Deserialize. from_ribbon is the only fresh public construction path and retains an admitted ring of rank1..32, aligned dimensions/twists and an n-by-n matrix; Clone preserves alignment under scalar value semantics. Its borrowed getters cannot resize those carriers. verified adds verify but returns the same type, so an arbitrary value of the type is not a sealed modularity certificate.

Balancing: precompute inv(theta_a),d_c*theta_c and b*. Each entry is inv(theta_a)*inv(theta_b)*sum_c N(a,b*,c)d_c*theta_c, without dropping multiplicities. The source convention equals the published N(a*,b) form by simultaneous duality N(a,b*)^c=N(a*,b)^(c*), d_(c*)=d_c and theta_(c*)=theta_c. The cyclic3 Fourier witness detects accidental omission of the dual; self-dual examples alone cannot establish that convention.

Coefficient safety: add_multiple preserves zero/one directly and admits u64->i64 before embedding larger coefficients. Public ribbon rings are multiplicity-free, but the helper still refuses a forged extreme coefficient. Every public genus is u32, so i64(genus)-1 lies in[-1,4294967294]. Its unsigned absolute value is computed before comparing to the pinned scalar exponent bound. Label and shape admission precede private indexing.

Ordered verification: after D^2!=0, the strict upper triangle yields the first asymmetric pair, exact rank then checks nondegeneracy, actual multiplication checks S^2=D^2*C, and actual conjugate transpose checks SS^dagger=D^2*I. Column scaling constructs ST and two ordered products construct its cube; equality to p+S^2 precedes the first provider Verlinde triple. Matrix mismatches scan row-major; shape disagreement is typed, never zip-truncated.

Root-index results: root_of_unity_data requires an advertised order1..4096 and scans powers until finding equality; its reduced(n,k) has0<=k<n. Multipliers4/8 are widened to u64 before multiplication and are bounded by32760. Rational denominators are positive and numerator/denominator remain BigInt. Mod8 additionally checks suppliedD^2, then a decidable positive sign before division. A returned root index is an angle in the advertised generator; canonical complex embeddings are additional hypotheses for physical central-charge terminology.

Second indicator: aligned cached u_b=d_b*theta_b^2 and v_c=d_c/theta_c^2 give sum_bc N(b,c,a)u_b v_c/D^2. The field factorization equals the raw squared-ratio formula; zero multiplicities skip unnecessary products, nonzero coefficients use checked embedding. Exactly1,-1,0 are admitted as i8; every other exact result carries FrobeniusSchur{label}. This computation is available on raw data too, so its mathematical interpretation is conditional on the required modular-category hypotheses.

Genus sum: group dimension squares by exact equality, preserving the total count n and positive counts<=32; replace each key in place with D^2/square. Equal squares yield equal ratios, so summing count*ratio^(g-1) equals the literal per-label sum in a lawful characteristic-zero field. The genus budget refuses before any grouping/division/power, zero denominators remain typed, and rational projection then nonnegative-integrality admission precedes BigInt extraction. Raw from_ribbon data is allowed, so a successful number is the specified exact formula; a physical state-space interpretation requires additional mathematical hypotheses.

Logical cost: balancing is O(n^3) field work with O(n^2) output and O(n) caches; inverses/dual lookups occur once per label. verify uses O(n^3) rank/products plus the existing O(n^4) full Verlinde defect provider, retaining up to O(n^3) defect triples. Reusing S^2 and direct ST/scaled C/I construction avoids unused unscaled/diagonal matrices and generic exponentiation products. Keeping the full provider result before first() is a limitation of the reused API, not a claim of streaming or an allocation-free provider.

Indicator work is O(n^2) with O(n) weights and no per-channel inverse. Genus grouping is O(n^2) equality work/O(n) retained pairs, one division and O(log(|g-1|+1)) repeated-squaring work per distinct square; the pinned provider exponent limit is2^20. Root lookup uses at most4096 scalar steps. Matrix constructors admit at most1024 entries due to the ring rank bound, even when the called default matrix APIs use UNLIMITED logical policies. Arbitrary field coefficient bit growth, allocation failure and operation implementation costs remain outside these bounds.

trust_boundary: Lawful immutable characteristic-zero exact field values, rational embedding, compatible conjugation and root generators; honest optional rational/sign projections. FusionScalar is an open protocol and cannot enforce those laws for arbitrary client implementations. Rust/compiler, pinned thiserror and exact matrix/ring/category/ribbon/scalar providers are explicit dependencies. Logical element/operation counts exclude scalar bit length, comparison/clone cost, allocator metadata and OS memory. No arbitrary client panic or allocator-totality theorem is asserted.

The private data fields and shared type mean callers must choose verified or call verify when modular checks are required. Immutable getters and Clone preserve shape, but no consumer may infer a fresh sealed certificate from the struct name.

Native fixtures independently check non-self-dual cyclic3 Fourier matrices, raw indicator rows, Ising/Fibonacci/semion/toric charges and genus values, all ordered defect stages and raw forged diagnostic boundaries. This is finite scoped evidence, not the full workspace or a reconstruction/classification theorem.

Balancing: precompute inv(theta_a),d_c*theta_c and b*. Each entry is inv(theta_a)*inv(theta_b)*sum_c N(a,b*,c)d_c*theta_c, without dropping multiplicities. The source convention equals the published N(a*,b) form by simultaneous duality N(a,b*)^c=N(a*,b)^(c*), d_(c*)=d_c and theta_(c*)=theta_c. The cyclic3 Fourier witness detects accidental omission of the dual; self-dual examples alone cannot establish that convention.

Coefficient safety: add_multiple preserves zero/one directly and admits u64->i64 before embedding larger coefficients. Public ribbon rings are multiplicity-free, but the helper still refuses a forged extreme coefficient. Every public genus is u32, so i64(genus)-1 lies in[-1,4294967294]. Its unsigned absolute value is computed before comparing to the pinned scalar exponent bound. Label and shape admission precede private indexing.

Ordered verification: after D^2!=0, the strict upper triangle yields the first asymmetric pair, exact rank then checks nondegeneracy, actual multiplication checks S^2=D^2*C, and actual conjugate transpose checks SS^dagger=D^2*I. Column scaling constructs ST and two ordered products construct its cube; equality to p+S^2 precedes the first provider Verlinde triple. Matrix mismatches scan row-major; shape disagreement is typed, never zip-truncated.

Root-index results: root_of_unity_data requires an advertised order1..4096 and scans powers until finding equality; its reduced(n,k) has0<=k<n. Multipliers4/8 are widened to u64 before multiplication and are bounded by32760. Rational denominators are positive and numerator/denominator remain BigInt. Mod8 additionally checks suppliedD^2, then a decidable positive sign before division. A returned root index is an angle in the advertised generator; canonical complex embeddings are additional hypotheses for physical central-charge terminology.

Second indicator: aligned cached u_b=d_b*theta_b^2 and v_c=d_c/theta_c^2 give sum_bc N(b,c,a)u_b v_c/D^2. The field factorization equals the raw squared-ratio formula; zero multiplicities skip unnecessary products, nonzero coefficients use checked embedding. Exactly1,-1,0 are admitted as i8; every other exact result carries FrobeniusSchur{label}. This computation is available on raw data too, so its mathematical interpretation is conditional on the required modular-category hypotheses.

Genus sum: group dimension squares by exact equality, preserving the total count n and positive counts<=32; replace each key in place with D^2/square. Equal squares yield equal ratios, so summing count*ratio^(g-1) equals the literal per-label sum in a lawful characteristic-zero field. The genus budget refuses before any grouping/division/power, zero denominators remain typed, and rational projection then nonnegative-integrality admission precedes BigInt extraction. Raw from_ribbon data is allowed, so a successful number is the specified exact formula; a physical state-space interpretation requires additional mathematical hypotheses.

Logical cost: balancing is O(n^3) field work with O(n^2) output and O(n) caches; inverses/dual lookups occur once per label. verify uses O(n^3) rank/products plus the existing O(n^4) full Verlinde defect provider, retaining up to O(n^3) defect triples. Reusing S^2 and direct ST/scaled C/I construction avoids unused unscaled/diagonal matrices and generic exponentiation products. Keeping the full provider result before first() is a limitation of the reused API, not a claim of streaming or an allocation-free provider.

Indicator work is O(n^2) with O(n) weights and no per-channel inverse. Genus grouping is O(n^2) equality work/O(n) retained pairs, one division and O(log(|g-1|+1)) repeated-squaring work per distinct square; the pinned provider exponent limit is2^20. Root lookup uses at most4096 scalar steps. Matrix constructors admit at most1024 entries due to the ring rank bound, even when the called default matrix APIs use UNLIMITED logical policies. Arbitrary field coefficient bit growth, allocation failure and operation implementation costs remain outside these bounds.
